title: Start a headless product from the composer and promote it to a build
goal: You want a REST API that shortens URLs, with rate limiting. Starting from ligma's home page and using nothing but the app itself, get that product described, agreed and handed to the builders — no terminal, no config file, no CLI.
steps: Describe the product you want in your own words on the home page: Build a REST API that shortens URLs, with rate limiting
Answer whatever the system asks in order to pin down what is being built, and confirm the shape it inferred for it
Satisfy yourself there is nowhere in this project to design screens — a service with no interface should not offer you a Studio
Open the step that turns the brief into work, directly from the brief itself
Read what it is about to commit to before you agree: the tasks, the acceptance criteria, the journeys and what it estimates it will spend
Confirm it, and find the resulting work on the board
